source: StatHead fit to completed two-team trades in public Sleeper dynasty and keeper leagues
unit: 100 = a mid 1st in the next rookie draft, the same week; additive (two 50s trade for one 100)
note: value: the newest week of a weekly random-walk fit. valueNwAgo: the same fit N weeks back (smoothed: it also uses later trades). trades8w / tradesAll: trades the player was in. idp: a defensive player, valued from IDP leagues only. Players in fewer than 20 trades are not fitted.

holdout.note: median |log(side A / side B)| on held-out leagues: per lambda, a static fit (one value per player for all time) and counting every asset as 1
